items.title: Flatness is the same over a local ring, over its henselization and over its strict henselization
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter flat.tex (More on Flatness)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file flat.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that flatness of a module over a local ring, over its henselization and over its strict henselization are equivalent conditions, with the expected variants when the module is pulled back from the local ring or from the henselization (statement lines 182-206, tag 05VL). Faithful flatness handles the downward implications and the descent equivalences, but the upward implication needs the up and down lemma for an etale neighbourhood together with the fact that the henselizations are directed colimits of the local rings of those neighbourhoods, plus the flatness criterion for a colimit. That colimit step is the substance, so the claim is H2.
